reuse.why: The flag is threaded into the existing isLockedForMonthFill predicate and getMonthFillCategories selection in month-fill.ts, which all six month-wide actions already use.

duplication.why: The rule is changed once; the only repetition is the same '{ month; includeHiddenCategories? }' argument type and default written out inline in six action signatures instead of a shared args type.

placement.why: The hidden-category exemption lives in budget/month-fill.ts with the other month-fill exclusions; actions.ts only forwards the flag.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the month-fill helpers and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: A single explicit parameter on the shared predicate, defaulting to the old behaviour, keeps the other exclusions untouched and is easy to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; copyPreviousMonth and the getMonthFillCategories callers all pass the flag to the shared predicate
